name: private-chef
description: A cook who shops and cooks a meal at the buyer's place.
howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at booking; a big dinner can be two escrows, a share at booking and the rest before the day. Done is the meal served and the kitchen left clean, and the buyer releases then. A timer to the seller, set past the day, pays for work done if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, share any allergies and agree who buys the food.
